title: Resolve Governance Policy through one bounded-context language
goal: Use the same explicit meanings when the Governance domain speaks about a policy, a recommendation, and a recommended action, and when DomainSpec classifies those concepts.

candidate_mappings.current_proposition: Governance Policy selects a strategy for treating reviewed Governance Rules.
The recommendation is the evidence-backed value returned by assessment and policy evaluation; whether it needs independent identity and lifecycle remains an owner decision.
The action is one value from the closed set keep, harden, simplify, merge, prune, or defer.

open_questions: Does Rule Review Recommendation need a designated identity and lifecycle, or is immutable equality-by-fields sufficient?
Which Operation, if any, persists the returned recommendation or creates the Governance Assessment record?
Which exact CyberAlchemy definitions should be promoted after the DomainSpec type mapping is accepted?
decision_owner: CyberAlchemy Governance owner with definitions-governance review
blocked_actions: formalizing or implementing an unresolved mapping
